set.body: When profiling assigns material cost to the graph boundary, optimize Graph4s in an isolated worktree through lawful indexed snapshots, graph-scoped indexed fields, or public bulk folds and copies rather than private-array coupling. Pass Graph4s JVM, Scala.js, and Native gates, pin the reviewed commit in Grakern, then rerun every semantic and performance court. Close as not applicable only with ownership evidence.
set.title: Eliminate measured Graph4s ingestion and packing losses
